name: auto-artifact-preview
description: Automatically renders saved Claude Artifact HTML files anywhere under a repo's docs/ tree in Live Preview instead of showing source, and collapses back to a single pane when you navigate away.
author: Andrew McKie

autoArtifactPreview.docsFolderNames.description: Top-level folder names to watch. An HTML file is auto-previewed when one of these appears as a path segment anywhere in its path (e.g. "docs" matches both docs/a.html and docs/site/b.html).

autoArtifactPreview.autoClosePreview.description: Automatically close the preview split once you navigate away to a different file. Disable to leave the preview open until you close it yourself.
